_readme: STAGE 2b DRAWN: THE TAIL'S TRAIN FROM ORBIT (2026-10-27, docs/WATER_V2.md 14.4). The 10 km stone of impact_tail.json,
the eye 3000 km over the impact an hour after it (the spin-up starts half an hour before the event; the ring is 700 km out); the far
field the globe draws is the tail's departure where the tail holds the point (shaders/TailRead.hlsli), exaggerated
10x as the drawn law was. Beside it the same still with the tail off (--set water.swe.tailCells=0) draws the law's
one-depth rings: the gate is the two stills side by side -- the tail's train over the real bed, the law's over 4000 m.
